scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.
header: REMAINING_XCR0 hi=<8 lowercase hex> lo=<8 lowercase hex>
allowed_rows: REMAINING component=<id> INAPPLICABLE reason=instruction-fault signal=4 trap=6 code=2
REMAINING component=<id> INAPPLICABLE reason=instruction-fault signal=11 trap=13 code=128
summary: REMAINING_COMPLETED applicable=<3 lowercase hex> inapplicable=<3 lowercase hex> stopped=<3 lowercase hex>
summary_rule: Masks derived from rows must be disjoint and partition 0x218; no unexplained bytes or duplicate rows; final LF and EOF required.
exit_rule: 2 exactly when stopped mask is nonzero, otherwise 0; stderr empty.
credit_rule: Only actual full-boundary PASS rows receive component preservation credit. INAPPLICABLE and STOP never do. All-inapplicable is completed observation only. Any STOP remains an unmet prerequisite, never acceptance.
